defects.what: The flooded evacuation street is lined with Japanese-style shop signs with katakana-like glyphs (large blue sign upper left, vertical sign upper right).
The street behind the glowing Lakandula has vertical Japanese-style signs with glyphs and lanterns down both sides, reading as Tokyo rather than Manila.
Black letterbox bars across the top and bottom of the picture (a frame inside the frame).
A sportswear-style three-stripe logo on the chest of the yellow jacket.
A small brand logo with lettering on the chest of the yellow jacket.
A small lit sign with an arrow and glyph lettering on the building at the lower right.
The slips of paper in the boxes carry scribbled pseudo-text, most visible lower right.
Small lit shop signs with glyphs along the left side of the street.
Tubal is drawn twice: once in front and again as a small figure standing in the boat behind him.
